name: Respecting The Elderly
overview: Scripture commands honoring and respecting the elderly as a reflection of reverence for God, emphasizing the value of their wisdom and experience. The Lord instructs us to honor our parents and rise before the aged, recognizing the gray head as a crown of glory when found in righteousness. The wisdom and understanding that come with age are portrayed as treasures to be esteemed, and disrespect toward elderly parents is explicitly forbidden. Together, these verses reveal that respecting the elderly is both a divine command and a recognition of the godly character cultivated through a lifetime.
